headline: Knicks Hold Off Timberwolves in Minnesota
summary: The Knicks beat the Timberwolves 102-99 behind Karl-Anthony Towns' 15th straight double-double, and the Texans routed the Colts 26-3 on Thursday Night Football. Also covered are Lane Hutson's overtime winner for Montreal, the Islanders' OT loss in Winnipeg, the end of McDavid's 23-game point streak, college hoops results, and tonight's slate.
